Send keys from the project's .env to the instance's script variables, asking before each

Usage: hpy happyview env push [OPTIONS] [KEY]...

Arguments:
  [KEY]...  Only these keys; each must be in the file (default: every key in it)

Options:
      --json             Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --url <URL>        The instance, e.g. https://api.example.com (default: HPY_HV_URL, else the
                         only one you are signed in to)
      --env-file <PATH>  Read the keys from this file instead of .env in the project root
      --no-input         Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need
                         --yes. Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>               Run as if started in DIR
      --dry-run          List each key as new or replacing an existing one, and send nothing
  -y, --yes              Send every key without asking
  -h, --help             Print help (see more with '--help')
